findings.title: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) - Flag Disclosure via Order Receipt Enumeration
findings.description: The order receipt endpoint /order/{order_id}/receipt is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR). By enumerating order IDs, an attacker can access receipts belonging to other users. The flag was found at order ID 300401.
